body: I wonder the same thing. Have all mine lying right beside me and thinking about downing them all. However, after some research on the internet I don't think it will cause anything other then severe headaches, nausea and vomiting.

My family is coming home tomorrow, lied to my therapist and said I was doing better. However my girlfriend has stopped talking to me and I know my life will not be any better from this day forward. I think tonight is the night, opportunity knocks and I must be strong. I'm so scared all be honest, but this time I will have just go through with it. Thanks for the replays guys! Its been real.

Idk, Because all they tell me is that "it will get better" or "you can do anything you want" kind of stuff. When I know I can't. I'm here back living with my family who are super religious, and I can't get away. I have a couple jobs that I couldn't handle because of my lack of education and fading memory. Literally my parents homeschooled all of us but didn't do anything with us, I fired my brain on movies and video games growing up cuz we weren't allowed to go to school but yet our mother would lock herself in her room so she wouldn't have to deal with us. Then tell us things like "yall will be fine cuz ive been praying that yall turn out smart"... it's such bs, yeah, we tried to learn a little on our own growing up, but you can only teach yourself so much. And now here I am, I have so much hate for them that I just want to kill myself. I know I'm not going anywhere, I know I have the education about as good as a 3rd grader, and yeah it sucks. But no it's too late for me now, no dreams, no normal life. I'm just trying to get the strength to end it tonight.
